title: Asymptotic Analysis of Discrete-Time Self-Attention Dynamics in Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.13518v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In machine learning, a self-attention dynamics describes the attention mechanism of transformers, and is obtained treating the layer index of a transformer as time index. Even though naturally discrete-time, this dynamical system is most often studied in continuous-time. Scope of this paper is to provide a thorough investigation of the discrete-time version of the self-attention dynamics: a complete classification of its equilibria is given, and their stability properties are studied, in both the single-head and the multihead case. We show that in both cases the main attractor of the dynamics is a consensus equilibrium aligned with the principal eigenvector of the value matrix (in the single-head case, a corresponding matrix of weights in the multihead case), even though other locally asymptotically stable bipartite equilibria can be show to exist at least in the single-head situation. translated_title: Transformer中离散时间自注意力动力学的渐近分析
translated_abstract: 在机器学习中，自注意力动力学描述了Transformer的注意力机制，它通过将Transformer的层索引视为时间索引而得到。尽管该动力系统本质上是离散时间的，但以往通常在连续时间框架下对其进行研究。本文旨在对离散时间版本的自注意力动力学进行全面深入的研究：在单头和多头两种情形下，给出了其平衡点的完整分类，并研究了这些平衡点的稳定性。我们证明，在这两种情形下，动力学的主要吸引子是与值矩阵主特征向量对齐的共识平衡点（单头情形下对应值矩阵，多头情形下对应权重矩阵）；同时，至少在单头情形下，还可以证明存在其他局部渐近稳定的二部平衡点。通过观察学习到的……（该行为得到了验证）
tldr: 本文首次对Transformer的离散时间自注意力动力学进行了系统研究，给出了单头与多头情形下平衡点的完整分类和稳定性分析，并证明其主要吸引子是与值矩阵主特征向量对齐的共识平衡点。
en_tdlr: This paper thoroughly investigates the discrete-time self-attention dynamics of transformers, providing a complete classification and stability analysis of equilibria in both single-head and multihead cases, and showing that the main attractor is a consensus equilibrium aligned with the principal eigenvector of the value matrix.
